turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.handover_hit: A team member will take over
turns.replyTail:
08 AM

I’m sorry to hear an item arrived damaged.

For damaged items, please contact us within 24 hours of delivery with photographs showing the damage. This helps us assist with a delivery insurance claim up to $100, and we can also help arrange a replacement or exchange. Claims after 24 hours can’t be accepted by the courier service.

A team member will take over from here. Please leave your email address so we can follow up.
